_comment: Copy this file to %USERPROFILE%\VisionStation\trainer.json and replace every value that starts with '['. The weekly run refuses to start while any value is still a placeholder. min_good and min_holdout are Quality's numbers, not engineering defaults.
store: [Engineer to define: local path of the synced evidence folder, the store/ of the SharePoint Quality/Automotive/VisionStation/evidence folder]
models: [Engineer to define: local path of the synced models folder]
reports: [Engineer to define: local path of the synced reports folder]
logs: [Engineer to define: local folder for weekly run logs, e.g. under %USERPROFILE%\VisionStation]
python: [Engineer to define: python.exe that has torch with CUDA installed, or 'py' if that is the one]

extractor.input_hw: [Engineer to define: input height and width in pixels]
extractor.weights_path: [Engineer to define: local path of the extractor weights file]
